$comment: Boundary fixtures for PPh Final Pasal 4(2) + UMKM migration (Task 7). Every expectation encodes a verified primary-source fact. UU PPh Pasal 4(2) authorizes final taxation for enumerated income. PP 46/2013: 1% final on business turnover, eligible WP OP/badan (not BUT), turnover <= Rp4.8bn, excludes professional services and income under another final regime. Effective 1 Juli 2013 - 30 Juni 2018. No duration limit. PP 23/2018: 0.5%, eligible OP/cooperative/CV/firma/PT, turnover <= Rp4.8bn, duration limits (OP 7yr, cooperative/CV/firma 4yr, PT 3yr; partial year counts as full). Effective 1 Juli 2018 - 19 Des 2022. Transition rule Pasal 10 for PP46-eligible-but-PP23-ineligible. PP 55/2022 original: 0.5%, effective 20 Des 2022, adds BUM Desa and one-person company; Pasal 69 preserves PP23 duration clocks; OP Rp500m exclusion is BASE exclusion (cumulative from first tax period, refreshes each tax year) NOT a second eligibility ceiling; Pasal 61 ceiling breach continues 0.5% through year-end. PP 20/2026 amends PP 55 effective 22 April 2026: narrows principal eligible types to OP, one-person company (single individual founder), cooperative; CV/firma/PT/BUM Desa legacy continuation under transitional; Pasal 59 deleted; tightened aggregation and professional-service rules. Land/building rent PP 34/2017: final 10% from 2 Jan 2018 (separate from UMKM 0.5%). Construction PP 9/2022 (amending PP 51/2008): final rates 1.75%/2.65%/4%/3.5%/6% by qualification from 21 Feb 2022. Transfer PP 34/2016: final 2.5%/1%/0% by category; effective ~8 Sep 2016. PPh 15 is a special net-income computation delegation (UU PPh Pasal 15), DISTINCT from Pasal 4(2); some PPh 15 taxes are final, some are creditable. Rates stored as decimal fractions (0.005 = 0.5%). Amounts are 2-decimal currency strings in IDR. See data/v2/sources.json for primary locators.

effectiveDate.$comment: UMKM chronology. PP 46/2013 effective 1 Juli 2013, replaced by PP 23/2018 effective 1 Juli 2018, replaced by PP 55/2022 effective 20 Des 2022, amended by PP 20/2026 effective 22 April 2026.

concepts.$comment: UMKM is its own concept family (pph-final-umkm). Land/building rent, construction, and transfer are distinct final PPh 4(2) objects. PPh 15 is separated out of PPh 4(2).

boundaries.description: PP 46/2013: 1% final on business turnover for an eligible WP OP with turnover <= Rp4.8bn. Effective 1 Juli 2013 - 30 Juni 2018.
PP 46/2013: eligible badan (PT) with turnover <= Rp4.8bn also gets 1% final. BUT is explicitly excluded.
PP 46/2013 last effective day is 30 Juni 2018. Boundary day must resolve 1%, NOT 0.5%.
PP 23/2018 effective 1 Juli 2018: 0.5% final. Boundary day must resolve 0.5%, NOT 1%.
PP 23/2018 Pasal 7: WP OP has a 7-year duration limit. An OP in year 4 (2021) is still within the limit.

PP 23/2018 Pasal 7: PT has a 3-year duration limit. A PT in year 4 has exceeded the limit (pp23DurationNotExceeded=false); the 0.5% final regime no longer applies. Resolver must NOT return 0.5% as tepat.
PP 23/2018 last effective day is 19 Des 2022. Boundary day must resolve 0.5%, NOT the PP 55/2022 rate regime.
PP 55/2022 effective 20 Des 2022: 0.5% final. Boundary day must resolve 0.5% under PP 55/2022, NOT PP 23/2018.
PP 55/2022 adds BUM Desa and one-person company to eligible entity types (original text). A BUM Desa with turnover <= Rp4.8bn qualifies under the original PP 55 text.
PP 55/2022 original text: PT remains an eligible entity type (carried over from PP 23/2018). Before the 22 April 2026 amendment, a PT still qualifies.

PP 55/2022 Pasal 3: turnover ceiling Rp4.8bn for eligibility. A WP with turnover 6.000.000.000 is NOT eligible (umkmTurnoverEligible=false). Resolver must NOT return 0.5% as tepat for the UMKM concept.

PP 20/2026 amends PP 55 effective 22 April 2026: narrows principal eligible types to OP, one-person company (single individual founder), cooperative. An OP after 22 April 2026 still qualifies under PP 20/2026. Boundary day must resolve 0.5% under PP 20/2026, NOT PP 55/2022.

PP 20/2026 narrows principal eligible types to OP, one-person company, cooperative. A PT is NO LONGER principally eligible after 22 April 2026 (legacy continuation only under transitional). Resolver must NOT return 0.5% as tepat for a newly-entering PT under PP 20/2026.
PP 20/2026: cooperative remains a principally eligible entity type. A cooperative after 22 April 2026 still qualifies.
PP 34/2017: final 10% on land/building rent from 2 Januari 2018. Boundary day must resolve 10%, NOT a pre-2018 PPh 23 final regime. Distinct from UMKM 0.5%.

PP 9/2022 (amending PP 51/2008): final construction rates by qualification from 21 Februari 2022. A besar-kualifikasi kontraktor gets 2.65%; kecil gets 4%. Boundary day must resolve the PP 9/2022 rate, NOT the pre-2022 rate.
PP 9/2022 effective 21 Februari 2022. Day before (20 Feb 2022) the PP 9/2022 rates must NOT yet apply — gap or pre-2022 regime, not the new 2.65%.
PP 9/2022: kecil-kualifikasi kontraktor gets 4% final on construction gross.
PP 34/2016: final 2.5% on transfer of land/building for perumahan/perkantoran/permukiman category. Effective ~8 Sep 2016.
PP 34/2016: final 1% on transfer of tanah dan bangunan sederhana category.

PPh 15 (UU PPh Pasal 15) is a special net-income computation delegation, DISTINCT from Pasal 4(2). Some PPh 15 taxes are final, some are creditable. The PPh 15 concept must NOT resolve under a PPh 4(2) category, and must NOT be flattened into the UMKM/final-rent/final-construction family.

umkmRateFractions.$comment: UMKM final rates stored as decimal fractions.

umkmDurationYears.$comment: PP 23/2018 duration limits (partial year counts as full). PP 46/2013 had NO duration limit.

umkmTurnoverThreshold.$comment: Eligibility turnover ceiling Rp4.8bn (inclusive) across PP 46/2013, PP 23/2018, PP 55/2022, PP 20/2026.
